reviewer: Codex source-by-source inspection, 2026-09-30; not an automated LLM judge
rubric: Review complete answers against retrieved text and implementation. Unknown delivery/refund details require explicit insufficient_context. Citations, confidence and keyword presence alone cannot pass.

cases.answer_quote:
The three supported order statuses are:
1. PENDING
2. CONFIRMED
3. CANCELLED

grounds.quote: Orders have exactly three supported statuses: PENDING, CONFIRMED and CANCELLED.
The Orders guide answers general documentation questions; use MCP for a particular order's current status.
It cannot establish a delivery date, shipment tracking number, refund entitlement or payment outcome.
The current API sets an existing order to CANCELLED regardless of its previous status, including CONFIRMED. It preserves the order and its items instead of deleting them.

cases.rationale: 답변은 정확히 PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED 세 상태를 나열한다. 검색된 order-statuses의 exactly three 문장과 schema.sql CHECK 및 database/app.py allowed_statuses와 일치한다. 추가 상태나 배송 완료를 주장하지 않는다.
